name: application-tree-view
title: Tree View
description: Expandable hierarchical node list with checkboxes, indent guides, and indeterminate parent state, driven by a typed recursive nodes prop contract.
useWhen: Selecting or browsing data with a parent-child structure, such as team/role permissions or nested categories.
Users need to bulk-select a group and all of its descendants via a single checkbox.
Content depth varies per branch and each level should be individually expandable.
avoidWhen: The hierarchy represents files and folders specifically — use a dedicated File Tree component with file-type icons instead.
The data is flat with no nesting — a plain list or checkbox group is simpler.
Every node must always be visible at once — a flat searchable list may scan faster than nested disclosure.
responsiveBehavior: The tree scrolls vertically within its own container on tall hierarchies; indentation compounds per depth level, so constrain nesting depth on narrow viewports.
accessibility: The root uses role='tree' with role='treeitem' rows and role='group' for nested children, per the WAI-ARIA tree pattern.
Expand/collapse toggles carry a dynamic aria-label naming the node so screen readers announce which branch will open or close.
A parent checkbox with a mixed-selection state sets the checkbox's indeterminate property, not just a visual dash.

variants.title: Tree View
variants.description: Two-level permissions tree with expand/collapse toggles, per-node checkboxes, an indeterminate parent state, and a selected-row highlight.
accessibility: The indeterminate checkbox state is set programmatically (element.indeterminate) since HTML has no indeterminate attribute.

variants.title: Tree View (Dark)
variants.description: Hierarchical checkbox tree adapted for dark surfaces with the same expand, checkbox, and selection structure.
accessibility: Indent guide lines, row text, and the selected-row fill must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
